title: [finding] security: a row-level `check` (declared, or defaulted from `using`) is never evaluated on an ARRAY insert — `engine.insert(object, [rows])`, which `createManyData` calls, stores rows a single-record insert refuses
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`, seat post #19357) from the out-of-scope findings of the #19953 dev (PR #19962, class a/b). ⛔ Filed unassigned and unlabelled: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The defect

The post-image row-level check does not run when the insert payload is an array.

**Read by this seat** on `main` `3b5607019f`:
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts:2997-3004` calls `computeWriteCheckFilter` only when `opCtx.operation` is `insert` or `update` **and** `!Array.isArray(opCtx.data)`.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:12852` (`createManyData`) calls `this.engine.insert(request.object, request.records, opts)` with the records array.

**Measured by the #19953 dev.** The harness was a real `SecurityPlugin`, `ObjectQL` and an in-memory `SqlDriver` at `3b5607019f`, with the object `qa_ticket` and the caller holding position `writer`.
- A sole declared `check` of `record.status != 'archived'` on an `insert` or `all` policy refuses a single-record insert of `archived` with `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403.
- `engine.insert('qa_ticket', [closed, archived], caller)` stores both rows.
- In the cases where every single-record insert is refused (an uncompilable sole `using` on `insert` / `all`; an uncompilable declared `check`), the array insert is still admitted.

The HTTP route for `createManyData` was NOT MEASURED. The engine-level call was.

**Contract.** ADR-0058 D4 (`docs/adr/0058-expression-and-predicate-surface.md:610`) enforces `check` "on the **write pre-image path** that already exists for by-id writes … and on the AST-injected bulk path". The multi-row UPDATE half is a separate, declared residual: #19950 covers a `check`-only policy that does not gate a `multi: true` update. This card is the INSERT half, which nothing covers.

Seam: `spec:RowLevelSecurityPolicySchema.check` → runtime: `plugin-security` `security-plugin.ts` step 3.6 (the non-array guard) ← `metadata-protocol` `createManyData`.

Dedupe words: `RLS check bulk insert array` · `post-image check skipped array payload` · `createManyData row-level check` · `ADR-0058 D4 bulk path check` · `insert array bypasses check`
